title: Addressing the Authoring agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Authoring agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `authoring-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Imperative and checkable
rules.description: Imperative and checkable. Give the rule, the reason it exists, and what a violation looks like — a rule with no failure mode gets reasoned around.

source.quote: Has the whole corpus available and no memory of the last session. Will follow the most specific instruction it can find and improvise when it finds none. Reads a skill before it reads the code.
